name: omega-mcp-router
description: One stdio MCP server that proxies many upstream MCP servers. Tool schemas load from a cache on disk, each upstream process starts only on the first tool call that needs it and closes after 15 idle minutes, and a session turns upstreams on and off for itself through router meta-tools. Upstreams are added with the bundled omega-mcp CLI.

npm.description: Local stdio server from npm (requires Node.js)

tools.name: router__list_upstreams
tools.description: List every upstream with its enabled state, whether it is locked, whether it is active in this session, its cached tool count, and the running child's pid and idle time.

tools.name: router__enable_upstream
tools.description: Activate an upstream for this session, optionally with environment variables for its process.

tools.name: router__disable_upstream
tools.description: Deactivate an upstream for this session and stop its process.

tools.name: router__refresh_upstream
tools.description: Start an upstream once, re-read its tool list, and cache it.

examples.title: See what is available
examples.prompt: Which MCP upstreams does the router have, and which are active?

examples.title: Turn on a server for this chat
examples.prompt: Enable the chrome-devtools upstream for this session.
